title: Kushner & KRE in Jersey City
note: Buildings developed by Kushner Companies (Charles, Jared and Nicole Kushner's firm) and by KRE Group / Kushner Real Estate Group (Jonathan Kushner's firm). They are separate companies. Partners are listed where the press or the developer names them.

buildings.name: The Journal (One Journal Square)
buildings.summary: Twin 52-story residential towers over a 12-story base next to the Journal Square PATH, about 40,000 SF of retail. Renamed The Journal in Nov 2024.

buildings.name: 30 Journal Square (proposed tower)
buildings.summary: Redesigned 71-story residential tower with a 14,000 SF public plaza, designed by Marchetto Higgins Stieve. Needs Planning Board approval of site plan amendments (P2025-0264).

buildings.name: 65 Bay Street (Trump Bay Street)
buildings.summary: 50-story rental tower with about 17,800 SF of ground-floor retail in Downtown Jersey City.

buildings.name: Journal Squared, Tower 1
buildings.summary: First tower of the three-tower Journal Squared rental complex by the Journal Square PATH.

buildings.name: Journal Squared, Tower 2
buildings.summary: Second and tallest Journal Squared tower.

buildings.name: Journal Squared, Tower 3
buildings.summary: Third Journal Squared tower; refinanced in 2025.

buildings.name: 808 Pavonia Avenue (proposed)
buildings.summary: Proposed 54-story KRE tower near Journal Square.

buildings.name: 813 Pavonia Avenue
buildings.summary: 48-story KRE tower near Journal Square, expected 2027.

buildings.name: 351 Marin
buildings.summary: 38-story rental tower a block north of Christopher Columbus Drive; leased up in five months.

buildings.name: 485 Marin
buildings.summary: Two 17-story towers with ground-floor retail in Hamilton Park.

buildings.name: 18 Park
buildings.summary: Downtown rental building at 18 Park Avenue; KRE's first project designed with Hollwich Kushner.

buildings.name: 235 Grand
buildings.summary: 46-story rental tower on the former Boys & Girls Club of Hudson County site.

buildings.name: 225 Grand
buildings.summary: Part of KRE's Northern Chapter rental portfolio, next to 235 Grand.

buildings.name: Grove Pointe
buildings.summary: KRE's first ground-up project in Jersey City: rentals at 100 and condominiums at 102 Christopher Columbus Drive.
